github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Follow the TML conventional commit format exactly: type(scope): description. Types: feat, fix, refactor, perf, test, docs, chore, ci, style, revert, wip. Type and scope must be lowercase. Subject must use imperative mood, max 72 characters, and no trailing period. Add a blank line before body or footer if present. Prefer scopes defined in the repo's commitlint.config.cjs; do not invent scopes when a listed scope fits.
